data.title: 阿斯特蕾亚 · 晨光羽落的忠诚依偎
data.description: 金灿灿的初阳洒在纯白的床单上，几根洁白的羽毛散落在凌乱的枕席间。阿斯特蕾亚侧躺在被窝里，单手护着胸前滑落的睡衣，白皙修长的双腿在晨曦中展露出毫无修饰的自然美感。她微微仰起头，金色眸子中盛满了像向日葵般灿烂的笑容，满心欢喜地迎接着两人同在的清晨。
data.location: sun-drenched morning bedroom with white ruffled sheets
data.action: lying on side in sunny bed, white sheets slightly pulled down, blonde hair spread around, white wings resting across mattress, radiant sunny morning smile
data.lighting: golden morning sunshine warming the entire bedroom with vibrant glow
data.mood: sunlit angelic bliss, unconditional loyal adoration
data.promptProse: Resting on her side on a sunny bed with white feathers scattered across the sheets, Astraea wears a light slip nightgown. Her white mechanical wings rest across the mattress as she beams with absolute, radiant loyalty.
data.animaCaption: Astraea lying on sunlit bedsheets with white feathers and wings, smiling radiantly.
